verdict.rationale: BVNK names one compliance mechanism specifically: a documented webhook fires when additional information is needed to comply with the Travel Rule for a crypto payment. Sanctions screening and wallet or address risk checks are never named anywhere in the evidence, so only one of the three named machineries is evidenced, and only thinly. Missing for 10: documented sanctions screening, documented wallet/blockchain-address risk scoring, an in-depth Travel Rule workflow (data fields, counterparty VASP handling), independent corroboration.
